title: What CRDT Internals Is All About
description: Conflict-free replicated data types: math that converges without coordination.. This database covers CRDT Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Replication is copying data for durability, availability, or scale.

Synchronous replication is safe but slow; asynchronous is fast but lossy.
